paper: CuRe: Learning Continuous Source Responses for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (arXiv 2609.14316)
training_set_in_paper: Trained only on GenImage SD-v1.4. The official release has no training code; SynthScope implements the paper's three-stage recipe (experiments/image/cure.sh, models/image/cure/README.md) and trained it on 3 GPUs (job 66658). The resulting checkpoint does NOT reproduce the paper (7.5-24 acc points below on every comparable benchmark, tags cure_trained_*); the official adapter does.

benchmarks.name: AIGIBench (20 full-image-synthesis subsets, full test data)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 2: unweighted macro-average over the 20 full-image-synthesis subsets.

our_number.note: Official adapter through SynthScope reproduces every one of the 20 subsets within 0.10 pt (92.85 acc / 97.48 AUROC). SynthScope-trained (paper recipe, tag cure_trained_aigibench20_full): acc 85.05 / AUROC 91.84 (not reproduced).

paper_number.note: Paper reports 82.0 for 'UnivFD' but does not specify the aggregation, so it is not directly comparable to the per-generator mean measured here.

our_number.note: UFD-8 mean balanced accuracy 93.94; 16-generator union 89.27 (aggregation differs from the paper). SynthScope-trained (paper recipe, tag cure_trained_ufd): acc 82.69 / AUROC 93.85 (reference).

paper_number.note: GAN half of the paper's UnivFD number (82.0); aggregation unspecified.

our_number.note: Mean balanced accuracy 81.95 (low scores are fake-recall; AP/AUROC are 95-99 on those generators). SynthScope-trained (paper recipe, tag cure_trained_forensynths): acc 75.83 / AUROC 93.56 (reference).

Official adapter through SynthScope: 79.69 balanced acc (mAP 87.39, AUROC 85.47) on the full released set (tag cure_realchain, job 251412). The release is one JPEG-q60 image set; the 7000 unpaired reals are split into 7 disjoint slices, so the mean per-generator balanced accuracy equals the pooled one. SynthScope-trained (paper recipe, tag cure_trained_realchain): acc 63.33 / AUROC 76.5 (not reproduced).
